hooks.prompt: A git commit was just made in this repo. Run `git show --stat HEAD` and `git diff HEAD~1 HEAD` (fall back to `git show HEAD` if there is no parent commit) to see what changed. Review the diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency issues, the same way /code-review would at medium effort. Report findings concisely as a short message to the user, ranked most-severe first. If there are no issues, say so in one line. Do not modify any files.
